entities.name: Jonas Čepulis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jonas Čepulis was a Lithuanian amateur heavyweight boxer who won a silver medal at the 1968 Olympics. He won his first three bouts by technical knockout (TKO), and lost in the finals by TKO to George Foreman.
